2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22314]Medieval Tiny Shed[/url]﻿﻿ (and all mods required by that mod).
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]﻿
4. Download the "[b](AT) Medieval Tiny Shed Retextures - [i](Recolour choice)[/i][/b]" mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
